suite.name: gemma4-e2b-cpu-sapphire-rapids
suite.description:
Gemma 4 E2B on x86 Intel Xeon AMX CPU (NUMA node 0 physical cores) across FP32, BF16, INT8, and INT4/INT2 model precisions:

- **OpenXLA** (with YNNPACK)
- **LiteRT-LM** (with XNNPACK and YNNPACK)
- **llama.cpp** (AVX-512 + AMX)
- **OpenVINO GenAI**
- **ONNX Runtime GenAI**

Frameworks are only benchmarked on data types where pre-built model artifacts exist (e.g., `llama.cpp` is omitted from FP32 because no pre-built F32 GGUF is published in `ggml-org/gemma-4-E2B-it-GGUF`).

llama.cpp.selected_by: NUMA node 0 thread scaling sweep t{4,8,16,20,32,40}

litert-lm.selected_by: NUMA node 0 thread scaling sweep t{4,8,16,20,32,40} x {XNNPACK, YNNPACK} (XNNPACK t=32 E2E winner)

litert-lm-ynnpack.selected_by: NUMA node 0 thread scaling sweep t{4,8,16,20,32,40} (YNNPACK)

xla.selected_by: NUMA node 0 thread scaling sweep t{4,8,16,20,32,40} (YNNPACK)

openvino.selected_by: NUMA node 0 thread scaling sweep t{4,8,16,20,32,40}

onnxruntime.selected_by: NUMA node 0 thread scaling sweep t{4,8,16,20,32,40}
